name: Kitahiroshima (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Kitahiroshima city emblem in white and yellow: three outlined loops forming a triangle around a yellow ring enclosing a stylised letter M.
history: Municipal flag of Kitahiroshima, a city in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 20 October 1969.

features.role: Kitahiroshima city emblem — three outlined loops forming a triangle around a yellow ring enclosing a stylised letter M
